"''Yes, all of them. Get Started.|Sotorus Ramda, and Orson Krennic|}} '''Sotorus Ramda''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] [[general]] from [[Rine-cathe 111]] in service of the [[Galactic Empire]]. He commanded the [[Scarif Deployment]] during the [[Battle of Scarif]]. He was relaxed in his duties as [[commander]] of the [[garrison]] on [[Scarif]]. This lax attitude, however, would cost Ramda dearly as it allowed a [[Rogue One|small team of rebels]] to infiltrate the complex in an attempt to steal the plans for the [[Death Star]], resulting in not only in one of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebellion's]] important victories of the [[Galactic Civil War]] but Ramda's own death when the security complex was destroyed by the Death Star's superlaser in an attempt to stop the theft of the plans. ==Biography== [[File:Sotorus_Ramda.png|thumb|left|200px|General Ramda]] General Sotorus Ramda commanded the Scarif Deployment [[garrison]]ed at the [[Imperial Center of Military Research|Imperial security complex]] on [[Scarif]] in [[1 BBY]], and was known to be relaxed in his duties there. The base was regarded as a place for long-serving [[officer]]s to wait out the [[Standard year|years]] until their retirement; with the [[Shield Gate]] considered to be an impenetrable defense, the garrison on the [[planet]] itself seemed almost ancillary. As a result of this lax leadership, Ramda was completely unprepared for the consequences of his hubris. In the [[Standard day|days]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin]], Ramda received [[Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]], who traveled to Scarif to investigate any and all transmissions sent by the now deceased [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[scientist]] [[Galen Walton Erso|Galen Erso]], who was the source of information of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] that was leaked and found its way to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]. Ramda obeyed, though he voiced his surprise at the magnitude of the order, as there was an abundance of transmissions that had been sent by Erso. [[File:Adema_Krennic_and_Ramda.png|thumb|right|225px|Sotorus Ramda (left) witnesses Director Krennic's arrival at the Citadel Tower.]] Not long after Krennic arrived on Scarif, [[Rogue One|Alliance special forces]] [[Battle of Scarif|infiltrated]] the Shield Gate [[space station]] that guarded the planet, and landed on the surface, launching a surprise attack on the Imperial complex in a bid to steal the [[Death Star plans]], and were later reinforced by an [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] led by [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]]. The Imperial security complex would eventually be destroyed in the final stages of the battle by the Death Star itself, as [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] ordered the battle station to fire upon Scarif in order to prevent the theft of the plans, and to eliminate his rival Krennic who sought to command the Death Star himself, killing Ramda in the process. Although the Alliance sustained heavy casualties, they were able to transmit the Death Star plans to the Alliance [[flagship]] ''[[Profundity]]'', and the plans were then by [[transport]]ed to the docked ''[[Tantive IV]]'' which escaped the battle. ==Behind the scenes== Ramda was played by [[Richard Cunningham]] in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' anthology]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''. ==Appearances== *''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} *[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]] {{Ab|Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (audiobook)}} *''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} *[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] *[[Rogue One Adaptation 5|''Rogue One Adaptation'' 5]] ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|Sotorus}} *''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|Scarif and Other Planets in the Outer Rim}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Sotorus Ramda |es=Sotorus Ramda |fr=Sotorus Ramda |ja=ソトラス・ラムダ |ka=სოტორუს რამდა |pl=Sotorus Ramda |uk=Соторус Рамда }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Ramda, Sotorus}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Army generals of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Males]]
